Commercial Cleaning

What's included

Every commercial client gets a written work schedule that lists each area, each task and how often it is done, from daily trash and restrooms to weekly high dusting. We clean with color-coded microfiber cloths, hospital-grade disinfecting all-purpose spray, HEPA backpack vacuums and a color-coded flat mopping system, and we close up exactly as you ask: lights off, doors locked and alarm set.

  • Entrances, lobbies, reception and waiting areas
  • Private, executive and general offices, conference, copy and file rooms
  • Restrooms cleaned, disinfected and restocked daily
  • Kitchens, lunchrooms and coffee areas, inside and outside the microwave
  • Trash emptied daily and taken to your designated area
  • Internal glass, sinks, drinking fountains and high-touch points
  • Weekly dusting of furniture, blinds, vents, light fixtures and baseboards
  • Daily HEPA vacuuming and damp mopping of every floor
  • Closing routine: janitor closet, lights, doors and alarm
  • One-year agreement with a fixed monthly price and scheduled quality inspections

Ideal for

  • Doctor's offices, clinics and hospitals
  • Laboratories and medical facilities
  • Car dealerships and showrooms
  • Churches, schools and offices

Frequently asked questions

What types of facilities do you clean?

Medical offices, clinics, hospitals and laboratories are our specialty. We also clean offices, car dealerships and showrooms, churches, schools and other commercial facilities.

When do you clean?

Most commercial service is done in the evening, Monday to Friday, so your staff, patients and customers are never interrupted. We can also work early mornings or weekends.

What does the contract include?

A written work schedule with every area and task, a fixed monthly price and a one-year term that renews automatically. Special services such as carpet extraction or floor stripping are quoted separately or included in the monthly price, as you prefer.

Do you provide paper products and soap?

We restock paper, soap and liners from your inventory, or we can supply them at competitive prices.

Can the contract change if our needs change?

Yes. We review the scope with you and adjust frequency or tasks when your space or schedule changes, and you always have one bilingual point of contact with scheduled quality inspections.
